about: Ten periodic orbits of Šuvakov & Dmitrašinović, PRL 110, 114301 (2013), Table I, integrated from its initial conditions (G = m = 1) with scipy's DOP853 at rtol = atol = 1e-12, sampled at the 200000 + 1 times (k + 1/2)·T/200000, k = 0 to 200000 (extended until the march ends on the side it starts on), over one period; kept are the two samples bracketing each sign change of the triangle's orientation, in order, positions only, in our body labels (ours 0, 1, 2 = Table I's 1, 3, 2; R-630 item 3), as [[x0, y0], [x1, y1], [x2, y2]]. 'published' is Table I's word written out; 'word' is the cyclically reduced word symbolic_dynamics_contract §1 reads from the kept states, and 'symmetry' the one R-630 item 5 needed to match it. Generated by fixtures/crossings/prl_orbits.py (adapted from the script RQ-632 was first read with, 30 Oct 2026; its 31 Oct line), never regenerated by CI; not transcribed from prin-rs.
